filters.name: Select Vertices by Expression
filters.shortDescription: Selects vertices for which a boolean expression evaluates true.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Boolean function using muparser lib to perform vertex selection over current mesh.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Seed for the `rnd()` and `randInt()` helpers, which only matter if your expression calls them. Zero draws a fresh seed on every run; any other value makes the expression exactly reproducible.

parameters.label: Alpha expression
parameters.help: Expression for alpha channel (ignored for geometry).

parameters.label: Random seed

filters.name: Define Custom Vertex Scalar Attribute
filters.shortDescription: Defines and fills a custom per-vertex scalar attribute.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Add a new Per-Vertex custom scalar attribute to current mesh and fill it with the defined function.
Attribute names must contain only letters, numbers and underscores.
The name specified for the attribute can be used in other filter functions.

parameters.label: Attribute Name
parameters.help: Name of the new custom attribute.

parameters.label: Scalar Function
parameters.help: Expression used to compute the scalar attribute.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Seed for the `rnd()` and `randInt()` helpers, which only matter if your expression calls them. Zero draws a fresh seed on every run; any other value makes the expression exactly reproducible.

filters.name: Create Grid
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Generate a new 2D Grid mesh with number of vertices on X and Y axis specified by user with absolute length/height.
It's possible to center Grid on origin.

parameters.label: Center On Origin
parameters.help: Centers the generated grid on origin.

filters.name: Create Isosurface from Expression
filters.shortDescription: Extracts an isosurface from an implicit scalar field.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Generate a new mesh that corresponds to the 0 valued isosurface defined by the scalar field generated by the given expression

parameters.label: Voxel Size
parameters.help: Sampling step used for volumetric evaluation.

parameters.label: Field Function
parameters.help: Scalar field expression f(x,y,z). The 0-isovalue is extracted.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Seed for the `rnd()` and `randInt()` helpers, which only matter if your expression calls them. Zero draws a fresh seed on every run; any other value makes the expression exactly reproducible.

filters.name: Refine by User Expression
filters.shortDescription: Refines edges selected by an expression and places split points by expressions.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Refine current mesh with user defined parameters.
Specify a Boolean Function needed to select which edges will be cut for refinement purpose.
Each edge is identified with first and second vertex.
Arguments accepted are first and second vertex attributes:

parameters.label: Edge Predicate
parameters.help: Boolean expression used to decide whether an edge is refined.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Seed for the `rnd()` and `randInt()` helpers, which only matter if your expression calls them. Zero draws a fresh seed on every run; any other value makes the expression exactly reproducible.
